mechanism: Valganciclovir causes nephrotoxicity and reduces renal clearance, while bumetanide's efficacy and toxicity are highly dependent on renal function; concurrent use increases risk of acute kidney injury and electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) closely and adjust bumetanide dosing based on GFR; consider alternative antivirals if possible and ensure adequate hydration.
